title: pvTest3DWidget
body:
## pvTest3DWidget

ParaView-internal test proxy: a vtkConeSource exposing only Resolution, with VTK's cone defaults (height 1, radius 0.5, apex along +x, centred at the origin). It exists to test 3-D widgets and has no analysis purpose; use pvCone or the curated cone operation for real cone geometry.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only the facet count can be changed; size, position and direction are fixed.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `Test3DWidget`. Identity: `sources/Test3DWidget`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Resolution` | Set the number of faces used to generate the cone. | `{"maximum":128,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```
